en.ammaar-muslim: [1/1541] al-Kafi: Ali from his father from Abdallah b. al-Mughira from Sama’a b. Mihran who said:

Abu Abdillah عليه السلام said: Verily the All-Mighty and Most-Powerful has sent down unto you His Book, and He is Truthful and Good. In it is news of you, news of those who came before you, news of those who will come after you, and news of Heaven and Earth. If there comes to you one who can inform you of that you will be amazed
